commands: set -eu; git fetch --prune origin; echo '=== HEAD ==='; git rev-parse HEAD; git status --short; echo '=== REMOTE BRANCHES ==='; git for-each-ref refs/remotes/origin --format='%(refname:short) %(objectname)' | sort

set -eu; echo '=== DOC FILES ==='; git ls-files 'docs/**' | sort; echo '=== ROOT DOCS ==='; git ls-files '*.md' | sort; echo '=== DOC SIZES ==='; git ls-files 'docs/**' '*.md' | sort -u > /tmp/growbox-doc-list.txt; while IFS= read -r f; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then bytes=$(wc -c < "$f" | tr -d ' '); lines=$(wc -l < "$f" | tr -d ' '); printf '%7s %6s %s\n' "$bytes" "$lines" "$f"; fi; done < /tmp/growbox-doc-list.txt

set -eu; echo '=== LIKELY DUPLICATE/HANDOFF REFERENCES ==='; rg -n 'FRESH_CHAT_BOOTSTRAP|CONTINUATION_PLAN|EINK_UI_HANDOFF|EINK_UI_NEW_CHAT_PROMPT|EINK_SCD41|ARCHITECTURE_HANDOFF|CURRENT_STATUS|PROJECT_ROADMAP' --glob '*.md' . || true

set -eu; echo '=== DOC HEADINGS ==='; git ls-files 'docs/*.md' | sort > /tmp/growbox-doc-md-list.txt; while IFS= read -r f; do echo "--- $f"; rg -m 10 '^#{1,3} ' "$f" || true; done < /tmp/growbox-doc-md-list.txt
